company_appendix_notes.rule: Use existing company-snapshot and authorized current company sources. Do not treat source marketing claims as current SAM/GSA/insurance/certification proof, and do not copy sensitive company identifiers.

company_appendix_notes.source_service_cycle: Page 16 role description mentions service every two weeks. That is a source narrative, not a universal contract requirement; the user-approved two-visits/month recommendation applies only when contract frequency is silent.
